about: Outreach Recruitment is recruiting on behalf of our client, a well-established Maltese company specialising in the supply and installation of products for residential, commercial and hospitality projects, for an experienced External Sales Executive / Business Development Representative to join their growing team in Luqa, Malta.

This is a field-based sales position for someone who enjoys meeting clients, building business relationships and finding new commercial opportunities. You will identify and approach potential clients, arrange appointments and face-to-face visits, and develop relationships with hotels, restaurants, care homes, contractors, architects and other commercial clients, presenting the company's range of furniture, hotel supplies, doors, glass and aluminium products, pergolas and balcony railings.

You will manage the full sales process from first contact to closing the deal, preparing quotations, negotiating terms and following up on opportunities. The role pays €2,000 per month, with a guaranteed minimum income during the first three months and an attractive commission structure thereafter. A valid driving licence and willingness to travel for client visits are required.

faq: What does an External Sales Executive do in this role?

You find and win new business in the field: approaching potential clients, arranging face-to-face visits, presenting products, preparing quotations, negotiating terms and managing each sale through to closing, while keeping in regular contact with existing customers.
What is the salary for this sales job in Luqa?
The role pays €2,000 per month, with a guaranteed minimum income during the first three months and an attractive commission structure thereafter based on sales performance.
Which clients and products will I work with?

You will sell to hotels, restaurants, care homes, contractors, architects and other commercial clients, covering hotel and restaurant furniture, hotel supplies, internal and hotel doors, glass and aluminium products, pergolas and balcony railings.

Previous experience in external sales, business development or a similar commercial role, with a proven ability to generate new business. Existing contacts in the hospitality, construction or commercial sectors are a strong advantage.
Do I need a driving licence?
Yes. A valid driving licence and willingness to travel for client visits are required.
